name: seated neutral-grip dumbbell front raise
description: An upright seated front raise with a dumbbell in each hand and palms facing each other. It primarily trains the front delts.
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with both feet planted on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell at each side with your palms facing in and your elbows slightly bent.
Raise both dumbbells forward together to about shoulder height. Keep your palms facing each other and your wrists straight.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging as you pause briefly at the top.
Lower both dumbbells slowly back to your sides.
